subject: Follow-up — Night Security Staff
body:
Detective,

We pulled the night shift roster for Valcourt BioLabs. Marcus Webb was the security guard on duty in the lobby booth the night Dr. Rask disappeared — he's the one monitoring the camera feeds, including the Level 3 corridor camera that dropped signal.

He was cooperative but seemed nervous when we spoke to him on scene. Might be worth reaching out directly through Messenger — sometimes people open up more once the uniforms have cleared out.

— Officer Reyes
